headline: NFL, NFLPA are "working together" to review Jalen Hurts situation
summary: As another full Sunday of football approaches, there's a new development in the situation regarding Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts, who is likely out for the rest of the year after a "superficial" blood clot became a deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in each lung.

headline: Lamar Jackson Out With High Ankle Sprain

headline: Browns DT Maliek Collins lands 2-year extension worth $30 million, agent says
summary: The Browns and DT Maliek Collins have agreed to terms on a two-year, $30M extension that includes $23M guaranteed, his agent told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Sources: Colts face big decisions on star players as NFL trade deadline looms
summary: The Colts are expected to field trade inquiries on some of their star players, including Jonathan Taylor, DeForest Buckner and Quenton Nelson.

headline: Texans activate WR Tank Dell to the active roster
summary: Tank Dell will play his first game in nearly two years on Sunday when the Texans play the Giants.
